== Museum Usage ==
[[File:Moonspire_museum.png|150px|left|A Moonspire in the [[Museum]].]]
* Minimum weight for maximum boost: 40kg
* Boosts: all the speed - {{Stat|Dig Speed}}, {{Stat|Shake Speed}}, {{Stat|WalkSpeed}}
* Maximum Boost: 0.32× each

<div style="clear:both;"></div>
== Trivia ==
* Moonspire gives exactly the same boost types in the [[Museum]] as the [[Modifiers#Lunar|Lunar modifier]].
* This is the only '''ore''' that gives Walk Speed - everything else that can affect that [[Stats|stat]] is an [[Equipment|equipment]], [[Relics#tabber-XP_Cookie|consumable]], or an ore modifier.
